verdict.rationale: Shortwave's MCP support is client-side: its own assistant connects out to other MCP servers, so it does not expose the mailbox to external agents and is not credited here. The only evidence of an outside agent acting on Shortwave mail is the Tasklet integration, which takes action on emails and places drafts in Shortwave. Probes for an OpenAPI spec, llms.txt and markdown docs all returned 404. Missing for 10: a documented API or first-party MCP server that Claude, ChatGPT or a custom agent can use; evidenced end-to-end read, triage and send by external agents; independent or hands-on corroboration.
